skill.name: find-flats-and-fill-forms
skill.description: Search rental portals for flats, pick the best listings and fill in the contact forms without sending them. Use when someone is looking for a flat to rent.
skill.summary: Delegate rental searches and contact-form preparation to MyClawn, leaving submission to the user.
skill.author: 20vision

content.user_title: Find Rental Flats and Prepare Enquiry Forms
content.value_statement: Searching rental portals and preparing repeated enquiries takes time. This skill delegates listing searches and contact-form preparation to MyClawn while leaving submission to you.
actual_capabilities: Compose a rental-search task using the user's city, flat size, budget, and enquiry message.
Request recent listings, a ranked shortlist, and links through the MyClawn Computer connector.
Delegate contact-form completion for selected listings while requiring a stop before submission.
Include target sites, expected results, and prohibited actions in the delegated task.
Report the connector's answer, final-screen screenshot, and screen-recording link.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; this skill contains no standalone browser automation.
Connector setup refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill that is not included in this package.
Users must handle portal logins, solve captchas, and submit prepared forms themselves.
Listing access, availability, and form completion depend on the portals and the external connector.

use_cases.title: Search for a first rental
use_cases.description: Request recent flats within a defined budget and prepare enquiries for the strongest matches without submitting them.

use_cases.title: Plan a move to another city
use_cases.description: Delegate a city-specific rental search and review listing links, a final-screen screenshot, and a recording.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a shared housing search
use_cases.description: Use agreed size, budget, and portal requirements to prepare consistent enquiries for selected flats.

prompt_templates.title: Find matching flats
prompt_templates.prompt: Find five rental flats in [city] with [room count] rooms and a monthly budget of [amount]. Return listing links. Do not contact anyone.

prompt_templates.title: Filter recent listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [portals] for [room count]-room flats in [city] under [budget including specified costs], listed within [days] days. Return the five best matches with links. Do not submit forms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: specify portals, costs, and listing age.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare selected enquiries
prompt_templates.prompt: Find five flats matching [criteria]. For the top three, fill contact forms using this message: [message]. Leave every form unsubmitted and return the result, screenshot, and recording link.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate a constrained search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [portals] for flats meeting [city, size, budget, and listing-age requirements]. Rank five matches by [priorities] and include links. Prepare contact forms for the top three using [message]. Stop for my login or captcha input when required. Do not submit forms, book anything, create accounts, or send messages. Return the answer, final-screen screenshot, and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define ranking priorities, interaction boundaries, and expected results.

output_examples.input: Find five recent two-room flats in Vienna under EUR 1,100 including heating. Do not contact anyone.
output: Illustrative result: five matching rental listings with links, ordered by fit.
The final-screen screenshot and screen-recording link accompany the connector result.

output_examples.input: Prepare contact forms for the top three matches using my enquiry message, but do not send them.
output: Illustrative result: contact forms for three selected listings are prepared with your message and remain unsubmitted.
Review the final-screen screenshot and recording before submitting forms yourself.

best_practices: Specify the city, room count, target portals, listing age, and whether the budget includes heating or other costs.
Provide the exact enquiry text and explicitly require every contact form to remain unsubmitted.
Review listing links, prepared messages, and returned visual evidence before sending anything yourself.
anti_patterns: Expecting the skill to run without a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector.
Requesting automatic submissions, bookings, account creation, or captcha bypass.
Including unnecessary sensitive personal information in enquiry text or browser fields.

faq.question: Does this skill send rental enquiries?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the connector to prepare forms and stop before submission. You press send.

faq.question: What must I set up first?
faq.answer: You need a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector. The skill refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill for setup.

faq.question: Can I change the city and budget?
faq.answer: Yes. The task replaces the example city, size, budget, and enquiry message with your requirements.

faq.question: How are portal logins and captchas handled?
faq.answer: You sign in when a portal requires it and solve captchas on the live screen. The skill does not bypass them.

faq.question: What results should I receive?
faq.answer: The workflow requests listing links and reports the connector's answer, a final-screen screenshot, and a screen-recording link.

faq.question: Does the skill include its own search engine?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for the MyClawn connector. Portal access and search execution depend on that external service.
